text:
jamie: quick heads-up — onboarding README cURL example caused a couple support tickets today (auth + dup requests).
fred: paste the snippet?
jamie: current block in quickstart: 
```
curl -X POST \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY " \n  -d '{"input":"ping"}' \n  --retry 3 
```
(tldr: trailing space after token, no Content-Type header, and --retry on POST)
tori: missing Content-Type often leads to 415 on some proxies/ingress. trailing space produced 401 then client retried — duplicate POSTs hit downstream systems.
docs-bot: automated linter: found 'Authorization' trailing-space pattern and missing Content-Type in quickstart. Recommend: (1) remove trailing space, (2) add Content-Type, (3) avoid --retry in copy/paste POST examples or show Idempotency-Key example, (4) include a single-line curl variant for safer copy/paste, (5) add a PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod example.
fred: propose we change canonical quickstart to use GET for the minimal flow, then show an embeddings POST example with an Idempotency-Key that demonstrates safe retries. also add a PS one-liner.
jamie: draft snippets to include in PR: 
```
# single-line (unix)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
```
# PowerShell
$env:REDWOOD_KEY = 'REPLACE'
$guid = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString()
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_KEY"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json'; 'Idempotency-Key' = $guid } -Body '{"input":"hello"}'
```
cli-bot: added docs lint rule request: flag any curl blocks containing '--retry' with POST/PUT/PATCH unless Idempotency-Key header present.
support: confirmed one customer had automation that created duplicates. after updating to the one-line curl + idempotency header they reported no more duplicates.
docs-bot: filed issue #6001: 'quickstart: curl header/content-type/retry hygiene' with suggested PR template.
fred: i'll open the PR to (a) remove trailing space (b) add Content-Type (c) swap canonical minimal to GET (d) add embeddings POST with Idempotency-Key + PS variant (e) add lint rule.
deploy-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2987 — once merged we'll roll to staging.
jamie: thanks — small docs hygiene but big real-world effect. please also add a short troubleshooting bullet: "If you see 401, check for trailing spaces and header prefix". closing loop when PR merges.
deploy-bot: PR merged and deployed to staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/quickstart :shipit:
